Dear Parent, This consent form aims to inform you about the nature of the comprehensive assessment process.

  1. 1. The comprehensive assessment is scheduled for two consecutive days from 9:00 am to 1:00pm- Clinical Psychology, Applied Behavior Analysis, Speech and Language Pathology and Occupational Therapy Assessment.
  2. 2. The presence of the primary caregiver is crucial as information about the history of clinical concerns of the child and family members is reviewed as part of the assessment and formulation.
    3. 3. As part of the comprehensive assessment, the client’s adaptive behavior is assessed using the Vineland Adaptive Behavior Scales. This assessment includes a Parent/Caregiver Form which assess the client’s home and family-life behavior using a questionnaire form completed by the parent or caregiver. This form is expected to be submitted within four days. The assessment is considered complete only when the forms are completely received back to the clinician.
  3. 4. A comprehensive written report outlining the assessment process, findings, formulation, diagnostic outcome, and recommendations is shared with the family only during the final report discussion.( In person/Online)
  4. 5. The reports will be formulated only in English, if needed only the summarized version of the clinical impression can be generated in Arabic.
  5. 6. Please be aware that we do not endorse the use of photography or videography as a part of the assessment process

I, have read, understood and agree with the consent form and the conditions stated.
